id: title:feliperalmeida:run the toolbox from inside the flox environment

review.posthog_relevance: Changes to PostHog CLI initialization and telemetry, including a fallback for the PostHog client and removal of an environment-dependent exit check.
review.reason: The chunk contains three hunks: P1.F3.H1 adds a try/except block around PostHog import and shortens the client timeout, which could prevent CLI hangs if PostHog is unavailable or slow; P1.F1.H1 adds telemetry capture and cleanup; P1.F2.H1 removes an FLOX_ENV-dependent exit check. These are localized, bounded changes. No tier 2 or 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on whether the PostHog dependency is critical and whether the timeout reduction prevents real-world hangs; the removal of the FLOX_ENV check could either help or hurt depending on the intended behavior, and the telemetry addition is not shown to have a clear benefit. No tier 2 or 3 systemic benefit is demonstrated.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single group. No tier assignment is made; the score is not assigned.
